logp.method_description: A stock solution was prepared for each Ru complex using dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) and diluted to 6 mL at a concentration of 50 µM using phosphate buffered saline (PBS, pH 7.4), with the final DMSO concentration being less than 5%. The absorbance spectrum was measured, then 6 mL of 1-octanol was added, and the resulting biphasic sample was mixed at room temperature for 2 hours using an IKA Trayster inversion mixer (60 rpm). Next, the aqueous layer was extracted, and its absorbance spectra was measured. Log D values were determined using the equation below with samples prepared and analyzed in triplicate: Log D7.4 = log((Abs@λmax before mixing / Abs@λmax after mixing) - 1)
